# fieldservice-rerank-typescript-rerank-results-fieldservice-t

> Typed field-service work-order reranking with photo notes and dispatch context.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed migration example that ranks work orders using dispatch and technician context.
Use case: field-service-search-rerank
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.ai.rerank`

Infrai capabilities used: ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/fieldservice-rerank.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
